title: The info icon on Credit Hold explains the term on hover
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has every standard term switched on, and you want to know what Credit Hold means.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • All twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Hover the info icon after the name "Credit Hold".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: after the name "Credit Hold" there is an info icon and then a lock icon. Hovering the info icon shows: "No invoices can be created for a customer on Credit Hold until their credit term is changed."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R8: “COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold each show, after the name, an info icon and a lock icon. Hovering the info icon shows:”
  • S1-R8, Credit Hold info icon: “Credit Hold: "No invoices can be created for a customer on Credit Hold until their credit term is changed."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover the info icon on Credit Hold | "No invoices can be created for a customer on Credit Hold until their credit term is changed." | Tooltip on hover”
  • Key Decisions: “The page explains every term inline in a Due column; only COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold carry an info tooltip.”
